staff_intro: Reviewers and administrators get access only by invitation. Each programme has one main reviewer and may have extra reviewers; an extra reviewer sees the programme only while allowed to assist.
staff_replace_label: Swap out the current main reviewer when accepted
staff_invite_failed: The invitation could not be sent.

domains_intro: Students can register only with an email address from one of these domains (exact match). Removing a domain stops new registrations; existing accounts keep working.
domains_empty_warning: No domain is allowed, so no student can register.

students_intro: Find a student and fix their study programme. Their open applications of this semester are withdrawn, their unsent draft is removed, and they get an email.

semesters_save_failed: The semester could not be saved.
